items.item_text: Required to hold a valid California driver's license, have a driving record that is in accordance with local policies/procedures, and/or enroll in the California Employer Pull Notice Program
Experience using and working with cleaning supplies in a professional environment along with using cleaning equipment and agents.
Experience working in a hospital setting (small animal veterinary or human) and experience working independently and managing time to ensure daily tasks are completed.
Animal handling experience to assist in the performance of veterinary medical treatments and procedures.

Want to be part of the most innovative veterinary team in the country? We are looking for an Advanced Veterinary Surgery Center Cleaner to work alongside our world leading faculty clinicians and technicians, helping them teach the next generation of veterinarians while also serving the animals and pet owners of our community.
As part of the top ranked UC Davis Veterinary Medical Teaching Hospital team, our technicians are provided with the following benefits:

Under supervision of the Center for Advanced Veterinary Surgery (CAVS) Supervisor, clean and disinfect working areas within CAVS including but not limited to surgical suites, surgical preparation room, post-anesthesia recovery room, radiology suite, open work areas, breakrooms and restrooms per protocol. Restocking of cleaning and surgical supplies including but not limited to, towels and soap, needles, syringes, surgical gloves, gowns, masks, and shoe covers. Clean and disinfect anesthesia machines, OR equipment, and all surfaces in operating rooms. Will be responsible for transporting bio-waste, laundry, and operating room equipment between the VMTH and CAVS.
Knowledge of medical terminology and disease processes.
Interpersonal skills to work with a diverse group of people, to include clients, clinicians, students and staff.
Knowledge of common hospital pathogens and methods of disinfection.
Skills to maintain inventory of supplies.
Knowledge of how-to operative an Autoclave.
